children: Cuentas entered a Power-as-a-Service and colocation agreement with Power Upp USA to support Bitcoin mining operations at a West Texas site. The deal contemplates up to ten 2.4 MW container sets (24 MW total), accommodating about 4,200 ASIC miners, with staged deployments every 90 days. One-time charges are $500,000 per container for ASICs plus a $90,000 security deposit each, while recurring fees include 5% of Gross Mining Revenues, $2,500 per month, and an energy charge of $0.05/kWh, subject to adjustments. The 36-month term includes an 80% minimum utilization take-or-pay and a Bitcoin price suspension option below $55,000, with potential termination without early fees.
: Power-as-a-service and colocation hosting agreement (up to 24 MW)
: Scale Bitcoin mining via hosted power and colocation in Texas
